node.title: Re^2: Regex: What does ?k: mean?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
For the curious (like me), the [https://metacpan.org/source/ABIGAIL/Regexp-Common-2016060801/lib/Regexp/Common.pm#L219|specific code] that implements this appears to be:

if (exists $flags{-keep}) { $pat =~ s/\Q(?k:/(/g; } else { $pat =~ s/\Q(?k:/(?:/g; }
